name: Soushunfu
source:
Love is hidden in each heart. 
Love that was never realized.
Love memories of distant days remain...
There are three school life short stories about the faint feeling of love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
爱隐藏在每个人的心中。
未能实现的爱。
遥远岁月中的爱情回忆依然留存…
这是三篇校园生活短篇，描写朦胧淡薄的爱意。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
